sloka: सेवमाने दृढम् सूर्ये दिशम् अन्तक सेविताम् ।विहीन तिलका इव स्त्री न उत्तरा दिक् प्रकाशते ॥३-१६-८॥
transliteration: sevamāne dṛḍham sūrye diśam antaka sevitām ।vihīna tilakā iva strī na uttarā dik prakāśate ॥3-16-8॥

translations.english: As the Sun has resorted to the direction (south) that serves the god of death, the north devoid of (the Sun) shines like a woman without the vermilion mark on the forehead.
